body: #1892 (TASK-1247 harvest): my independent review is APPROVE on the code (verdict at .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1892.json; ADR-42 accepted) but CI is RED on the Rust-test portability ratchet, so I can't merge: aida-cli-lib/src/harvest.rs:1016  and :1028 the matching assert — absolute /tmp literal in a test. Fix (test-only): build the path from tempfile::tempdir() (already a dev-dep, used in config_reads_harvest_section_with_strict_defaults) and assert , or use a relative Path::new("harvest-out.json"). Push the fixup to task-1247-work; I'll eyeball the diff and ship on green. Also: #1890 merged (main 179e0961f, ledgered on TASK-1244); the drain landed BUG-1187 (#1891) itself. FYI pr ship refused with the in-drive guard while the drain runs — filed TASK-1253 to narrow it to the drive's own PR; I used AIDA_PR_SHIP_ALLOW_IN_DRIVE=1 for the two guided merges.
